The present appeal is filed by the appellant against the judgment of conviction dated 15.09.2025 and order on sentence dated 04.10.2025, passed by learned Additional Sessions Judge (POCSO)-06,
West District, Tis Hazari Couts, Delhi in SC No. 326/2021 arising out of FIR No. 394/2020 registered at police station Mundka for the offences under Sections 363/376 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 ('IPC') and Section 6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 ('POCSO').
2. Issue notice.
3. The learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State accepts notice.
4. Let the Status Report be filed before the next date of hearing.
This is a digitally signed order.
